# Express Pharmacy & DME (ExpressRx)

> Columbus, Ohio pharmacy providing custom compounding, durable medical equipment (DME), long-term care pharmacy, and specialty pharmacy services. 24/7 pharmacist access, statewide prescription delivery, and 100% cash-pay options with no insurance required.

Express Pharmacy & DME is a licensed Ohio pharmacy led by a physician-pharmacist team. It serves individual patients, assisted living and skilled nursing facilities, prescribers, and employers across Ohio.

Key phone numbers:
- Main line (patients): (614) 495-9097
- Fax: (614) 448-3757
- Email: info@expressrxdme.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 9AM–7PM, Sun 1PM–7PM (24/7 pharmacist on call)

## Services

- [Storefront catalog](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/storefront): Cash-pay OTC and everyday pharmacy products with categories for meds, wellness, DME, and personal care.
- [Compounding](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/services/compounding): Custom medications — pediatric liquids, allergen-free formulations, creams, and veterinary compounding.
- [Durable Medical Equipment](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/services/dme): Mobility, respiratory, and recovery equipment with insurance billing support and fitting.
- [Long-Term Care Pharmacy](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/services/long-term-care): Unit-dose packaging, medication management, and delivery for facilities.
- [Specialty Pharmacy](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/services/specialty): High-cost and limited-distribution therapies with copay assistance and therapy management.
- [For Providers](https://express-rx-pharmacy.vercel.app/services/for-providers): e-Rx, fax, and online referrals; prior authorization support; dedicated liaison.
